gloss: Kokugikan; sumo arena (esp. in Ryōgoku, Tokyo)

definitions.explanation: An arena built for sumo wrestling. By default refers to the {両国|りょうごく}{国技館|こくぎかん} in Tokyo, the main venue for grand sumo tournaments in eastern Japan.

examples.japanese: {国技館|こくぎかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{相撲|すもう}→相撲：00390_sumou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched sumo at the Kokugikan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうごく}→両国：28395_ryougoku⟧{国技館|こくぎかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}した→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。

examples.japanese: {国技館|こくぎかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ちゃんこ{鍋|なべ}→ちゃんこ鍋：24241_chankonabe⟧⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
Literally "national-sport hall," from ⟦{国技|こくぎ}→国技：10116_kokugi⟧ (national sport) + ⟦{館|かん}→館：17308_kan⟧ (hall). The current arena in Ryōgoku opened in 1985 and hosts three of the six annual sumo tournaments.
